methodology.loc: Physical lines containing at least one non-whitespace parsed TypeScript/JavaScript token; comment trivia and blank token lines excluded. CSS/SCSS uses quote-aware comment removal; CSS block comments and SCSS block/line comments excluded. Tokens inside multiline template strings remain code, including embedded text that looks like comments.
methodology.inventory: Production roots enumerated from working tree; auxiliary source from git ls-files. Identical production categories apply to baseline and final, including new production modules. Handwritten d.ts and adapted opencode-file/opencode-markdown modules conservatively included.

exclusions.reason: Tests, specs, fixtures, and explicit large-session-fixture.ts benchmark fixture.
Pinned OpenCode upstream styles, MIT header/license evidence; theme.scss generated verbatim by token resolvers.

methodology.functions: Every function declaration/expression, arrow, method, constructor, getter and setter with body. Length includes nested function source; nesting/complexity exclude nested function bodies. Cyclomatic is 1 plus if/loop/catch/conditional/case and logical &&, ||, ?? nodes.
methodology.dependencies: TypeScript resolution with repository aliases; imports, exports, import types, dynamic imports and require calls; CSS/SCSS @use/@forward/@import plus TS stylesheet imports. typeOnly means explicitly type-only syntax, not inferred runtime erasure. Cycle counts are strongly connected components, not every simple cycle.
methodology.duplication: Exact token sequence with whitespace/comments ignored; function signatures plus bodies and non-function blocks. No identifier renaming or semantic equivalence claims; nested overlapping matches cannot be summed as removable LOC.
methodology.exports: TypeScript checker aliases resolved and cross-file identifier references counted across production, tests and scripts. No production consumer is an investigation candidate, not proof of dead code. Entry points, string-based access, worker entry files, public contracts, dormant adapters and transitive reexports require manual review.
methodology.dependenciesNotImported: Package dependency with no direct primary-code import is only a candidate; scripts, stylesheet imports, workers, transitive integrations and packaging may require it.
methodology.build: Sum of stat.size for regular files recursively under out; logical uncompressed bytes, separate from disk allocation/package/install size. Build provenance supplied by coordinator validation.
